recognize_zh: 移植後病人雙側足背、腳踝及小腿出現對稱的紅色斑疹／麻疹樣（morbilliform）皮疹，於足背與腳趾處融合成片——肢端（手掌、腳掌、足背）受侵犯是急性移植物抗宿主病（acute GVHD）皮膚表現的常見分布。
features: Symmetric erythematous macular to morbilliform eruption on both distal legs, ankles and dorsal feet
Small discrete macules on the shins becoming confluent erythema over the dorsal feet and toes
No bullae, erosions, sclerosis or lichenoid papules visible
describe_en: Clinical photograph of both lower legs and feet shows a symmetric erythematous macular to morbilliform eruption involving the shins and ankles, becoming confluent over the dorsal feet and toes. There are no visible bullae, erosions, sclerotic plaques or lichenoid lesions. In a post-allogeneic transplant setting, the acral-predominant morbilliform rash is consistent with cutaneous acute graft-versus-host disease; a skin biopsy (interface dermatitis with basal vacuolization and apoptotic keratinocytes) and exclusion of drug and viral causes are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Drug eruptions typically begin on the trunk with a temporal link to a new drug and show eosinophils on biopsy, whereas GVHD favors acral sites, ears and face with basal apoptotic keratinocytes.
Occurs around neutrophil recovery with fever, capillary leak and pulmonary infiltrates, and resolves quickly with brief steroids.
Requires viral PCR in blood or tissue; histology lacks the prominent satellite cell necrosis of GVHD.
Vasculitis produces palpable purpura that does not blanch, unlike the blanching macular erythema here.
